padarn_owner.text: Bore da, welcome! Tea, toast, Welsh cakes. We do not do anything with kale.
Welsh cakes were cooked on a bakestone, so in Welsh they are called picau ar y maen, which means cakes on the stone.
Llyn Padarn outside has a rare fish called the Welsh char, or torgoch. It has been here since the Ice Age.

then.text: Another slice? You will be buying the cafe next. Off you go, cariad.

else.text: Here, take a slice of bara brith for the path. It is a Welsh tea loaf full of dried fruit.
